therapeutics.precautions: Aconitum is highly toxic. Raw/unpurified Vatsanabha must not be used internally; use only authenticated, properly processed material under qualified supervision.

formulations.name: Sanjivani Vati
formulations.reference: Sharangadhara Samhita Madhyama Khanda 7/18-19; contains Shuddha Vatsanabha.

आग्नेयं वातकफहृद्योगवाहिमदावहम् ॥
